theme: Mid-July peak green - the Dal glass-still at dawn, Mughal gardens in full bloom, Gulmarg's meadows carpeted with wildflowers while the plains bake
season: Mid-summer (12 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway (registration 3 Jul - 12 Aug), so Pahalgam and Sonamarg roads run heavy with pilgrim traffic; start early and book ahead. Srinagar is warm by day and cool at dawn (~15-30C) with brief afternoon showers possible; the Mughal gardens are in full bloom and the Dal is calm and glass-still at first light. Gulmarg and the high meadows are lush and green with wildflowers out and the gondola running, while the plains sit above 40C. Valley travel runs roughly 7am-6pm.
campaign_name: Kashmir Deep-green Dal dawn, gardens in bloom [INR] - 12 Jul 2026
subject: July in Kashmir is deep green and wide awake
